content:
A junior lawyer's fitness routine:




🏃 Running from Court No. 1
🏃 to Court No. 8
🏃 back to Filing
🏃 then to the photocopy shop
🏃 then back because "Matter has been taken up."
Who needs a gym? 😅
comment: Court practice builds stamina, but the hidden challenge is managing energy and attention. The best juniors learn to balance constant movement with staying sharp for the matters that truly need focus.
